author: ToolUp Analytics Ltd (UK)
name: ToolUp Platform SDK Packaged Module
description: A ToolUp Platform module as its own repository, distributed as a NuGet package: packable project plus a fable/ shadow project carrying the client tier as source, a FAKE Pack pipeline into a configurable local feed, run.ps1, central package management, tool manifest, and BOTH conformance layers pre-wired — the module-seam contract pack bound in a test project, and the packaged-layout shadow-project check chained ahead of Pack. Use platformsdk-module instead for a module that lives inside the deployment.

namespace-root.description: The single top-level F# namespace root every type in the package sits under (e.g. Contoso.Orders). Feeds the module-contract pack's namespace law — two packages each exporting a bare `DatasetView` cannot compose into one deployment. Defaults to the template name.

display-name.description: Human-readable module name, shown in the sidebar and used as the package description's subject. Defaults to the template name.

datatype.description: The DataTypeId the module registers. That id IS the wire TypeName its Process stamps onto emitted data, and the client's data gate keys on it — one literal in SharedTypes.fs drives both.

feed.description: Folder feed the Pack target writes to, and an extra restore source in nuget.config. The only machine-shaped path in the generated repo; delete the `local` source from nuget.config if you consume released versions only.

sdk-version.description: ToolUp.* SDK version. Drives every ToolUp.* pin through $(ToolUpSdkVersion) in Directory.Packages.props; keep it in lockstep with the deployments that consume the module.

license.description: SPDX licence expression for PackageLicenseExpression. Replace the placeholder LICENSE file with the matching text before publishing.

manualInstructions.text: Run `pwsh ./run.ps1` — format check, build, both conformance layers, tests.
Replace the placeholder LICENSE with real licence text matching PackageLicenseExpression in Directory.Build.props.
Set Authors in Directory.Build.props, then replace the echo routine and placeholder data type with your domain.
`pwsh ./run.ps1 -Pack` packs into the configured local feed; Pack cannot be reached without both conformance layers passing.
